properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's North-blocks pass: real OSM building footprint, a multipolygon with two small interior courtyard/light-well holes preserved rather than filled in. 255 Berry -- a Signature Properties condo building, built 2004, informally 'Signature I' to 235 Berry St's 'Signature II' (see that file's note on naming). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: (1) The developer is Signature Development Group, not 'Signature Properties', and its project page (signaturedevelopment.com/development/255-berry/) gives a development date range of 2001-2004 rather than a built year; neither is in the cited OSM relation. It describes 255 Berry as an 'eco-chic condominium development ... 99 lofts and condominium units'. (2) The informal 'Signature I' / 'Signature II' naming is withdrawn: no cited source uses it. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against data/raw/parcels.geojson in the 2026-09 audit; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).'. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8708009 (3,989 m2, active, mapped 2003-09-22); the earlier outline of 3,846 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.85 (94% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 91% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). The lot is condominium-mapped: 100 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8708009 and 99 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. geometry_type stays 'real'. Previous digitized_from: 'OpenStreetMap (relation 3831604, 255 Berry St)'. Previous accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents the whole building and the building cannot be mapped from a single Assessor parcel the way a single-owner building can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against the same parcel data in September 2026; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).'. 2026-10-12 audit text fix (no change to shape, status, use or geometry_type): (1) The sentence above that calls Avalon I condo-mapped is not supported: a DataSF Assessor address search (acdm-wktn) for 255 King St, Avalon I's address, returns one active lot (8706014), not per-unit lots; Madrone and Radiance were not re-checked in this fix. (2) The 'built 2004' in the opening wording is supported by the Assessor roll, not by the OSM relation: the DataSF secured roll (wv5m-vpq2) for 2025 gives year_property_built 2004 for lot 8708009 and for 255 Berry's per-unit lots; the year is the Assessor's year built, not a completion or opening date.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8708009 (3,989 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 100 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8708009 and 99 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (relation 3831604, 255 Berry St)); 94% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 91% of the lot.
properties.notes: 99 lofts and condominium units and the architect (McLarand Vasquez Emsiek & Partners) per Signature Development Group's project page; the OSM relation itself gives only building=yes.
